rawArticles.title: Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in OpenSSH (CVE-2026-3829)
Active Ransomware Campaign Targeting Enterprise VMware ESXi Servers
rawArticles.content:
Threat analysts have identified a coordinated ransomware campaign targeting unpatched VMware ESXi systems. The threat group, tracked as Storm-1204, leverages compromised administrator credentials to access the ESXi command-line interface. Once inside, they execute Python-based payload modules that encrypt virtual machine disk images (.vmdk files).

### Mitigation Guidance
Verify that SSH access is disabled on all ESXi hosts. Upgrade hypervisors to ESXi 8.0 Update 3 or later. Limit vCenter Server access to trusted internal IP ranges.

versions.content:
# Security Advisory: OpenSSH Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-3829)

A critical regression vulnerability was discovered in the OpenSSH server (`sshd`) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution on glibc-based Linux systems.
